summary: Code-level verification of date-standardisation fixes across StaffPortfolio (CareCertGroupedView + MeetingChips + meeting list), ExportTab, TranscriptExportTab, and TeamInsights (PersonGroups timeline + AI Accuracy CSV). All reported code changes are confirmed in place. Repo-wide grep sweeps for stray raw-ISO slice(0,10) and non-en-GB toLocaleDateString come back clean. Live UI verification via Playwright was blocked by the previously-documented headless-browser login quirk in this preview env (same issue flagged in iteration_170 context note) — login POST does not establish the session cookie under Playwright, so protected routes bounce back to /login. All textual/content checks were done against the built source instead.

StaffPortfolio.js.CareCertGroupedView (Care Cert tab, the: line 226 uses formatDate(r.date) — confirmed, raw .slice(0,10) removed

code_verification_results.utils/dateFormat.js: formatDate, formatDateTime, formatDayMonth, formatMonthYear ALL explicitly pass 'en-GB' locale with { day:'numeric', month:'short', year:'numeric' } — guaranteed to never render American MM/DD/YYYY.

repo_wide_regression_grep.cmd1_result: Only 2 hits — SuperAdminOrgDetail.js lines 161 & 164 feeding <input type="date"> form state (requires ISO YYYY-MM-DD by HTML spec). Expected and correct, NOT a bug.
repo_wide_regression_grep.cmd2_result: Only 1 hit — TranscriptTab.js:686 `wordCount.toLocaleString()` which formats a NUMBER (word count), not a date. Zero stray date formatters without en-GB locale.

live_ui_test_attempt.reason: Playwright login POST to /login does not persist session cookie in this preview env (documented quirk — same observation as iteration_170). After submitting admin@supervision.com / Admin123!X the browser remains on /login and /portfolio redirects back to /login. Not an app bug — reproduces iteration_170's note.
live_ui_test_attempt.mitigation_used: Full source-code audit of all modified files + repo-wide regex sweeps for American date formats and raw ISO leaks.

critical_code_review_comments: Minor: formatUkDate in TeamInsights.js duplicates logic from utils/dateFormat.js formatDate — recommend importing the shared util for a single source of truth (not blocking, cosmetic).
All date-rendering code paths now funnel through en-GB locale helpers — no American MM/DD/YYYY output is reachable.

success_rate.frontend: 100% at code level, UI not browser-verified due to env auth quirk

context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration_170 misses are code-level verified fixed: CareCertGroupedView (StaffPortfolio.js:226), ExportTab:112, TranscriptExportTab:90, TeamInsights PersonGroups:840/851 + CSV:1215. Only remaining .slice(0,10) usages are legitimate HTML date-input form state in SuperAdminOrgDetail.js. Only remaining non-en-GB toLocaleString is a number formatter (not a date) in TranscriptTab.js:686. If browser login quirk is resolved in a future env, a live screenshot pass on /portfolio Care Cert tab + Admin Export tab + Team Insights PersonGroups would be the full confirmation; the code is already correct.
rca of the issue: n/a — this round is verification of a prior fix, not a bug hunt.
